cardDesc: Five days in the jungle outside Tulum: a full transformative immersion in medicine ceremony, breath, and integration. Not a vacation, a reverent container for those seeking something more for their lives.
body: This is not a little yoga retreat or a simple vacation. This is a full transformative immersion.

Based on my years of experience working in this space, I have intentionally curated these retreat containers so participants can step away from the distractions of everyday life and fully immerse themselves in the experience, the medicine, and the integration process.

Participants receive support before arriving, experience the retreat alongside trained practitioners, and have the opportunity to integrate on-site throughout the experience. Preparation and integration support are included as part of the retreat experience.

pricing.title: Retreat pricing
pricing.note: Early bird pricing is available during the month of October only. Reserve your spot in October to receive $500 off the regular price. An $800 non-refundable deposit reserves your spot and is applied to your overall retreat cost. The remaining balance is due in full no later than one week before the retreat begins.

features.title: Location
features.text: A private retreat property in the jungle outside of Tulum, Mexico, with an on-site private cenote. Our group has the space entirely to ourselves for the duration of the experience.

features.title: Dates and arrival
features.text: April 1 to 5. Five days and four nights. Plan to arrive before 2pm on April 1st.

features.title: The medicine
features.text: One Kambo ceremony and three Bufo ceremonies, held with reverence alongside trained practitioners, woven together with daily breathwork and daily integration.

features.title: Who it is for
features.text: Co-ed and open to both men and women over 18 who are ready for a full transformative immersion. Every participant completes a clarity call and screening process prior to acceptance.

includes.title: What's included
items: Five days and four nights of accommodations
Access to an on-site private cenote
Handcrafted, organic meals prepared by our private on-site chef
Integration support throughout the retreat experience

intro:
Tulum, Mexico | April 1–5 | Five Days, Four Nights

The Reverence Retreat is for those who know they are ready for something deeper.

This is an intentional container built around reverence: respect for ourselves, respect for the land that will hold us, and deep respect for the medicine we will have the opportunity to work with.

For five days, you will have the space to disconnect from the distractions and responsibilities of everyday life and give your full attention to yourself. Through breathwork, medicine, ceremony, nature, and integration, you will be invited to slow down, listen, and take care of yourself in ways that can be difficult to do when life is constantly demanding your attention.

This is time intentionally set aside to meet yourself, take care of yourself, and give yourself the space you deserve.

faq.a: Yes. This retreat is open to both men and women over the age of 18.

The retreat takes place at a private retreat property in the jungle outside of Tulum. Guests are transported to the property, and our group has the retreat space to ourselves for the duration of the experience.

faq.q: Can I attend if I am taking antidepressants or mood stabilizers?
faq.a: No. Participants must be off all pharmaceutical medications to attend this retreat. Every participant also goes through our screening process prior to acceptance.

Guests can fly directly into Tulum International Airport. Cancun International Airport is also an option, as long as you arrange your own transportation to and from the retreat. You must arrive before 2pm on April 1st.
No. Airfare is not included in the retreat price. Guests are responsible for booking their own flights, and we recommend purchasing travel insurance.

faq.q: How do I reserve my spot?
faq.a: An $800 non-refundable deposit is required to reserve your spot and is applied to the overall retreat cost.

faq.q: When is the remaining balance due?
faq.a: The remaining retreat balance must be paid in full no later than one week before the retreat begins.
